decision_rule: a comparison supports its hypothesis only if the 95 percent paired bootstrap interval over prompt groups excludes zero in the hypothesized direction; an interval crossing zero is no detected difference

primary_comparisons.hypothesis: H-BD1, that the state-conditioned ridge predicts the target with lower prompt-aggregated MAE than the visible-information ridge
primary_comparisons.interpretation: No detected difference. The 95 percent paired interval [-0.025723, 0.000029] crosses zero, so H-BD1, that the state-conditioned ridge predicts the target with lower prompt-aggregated MAE than the visible-information ridge is not supported. Under the preregistered decision rule this is a null result and must not be described as a trend or a direction of travel.
primary_comparisons.name: visible_information minus true_state

primary_comparisons.hypothesis: H-BD2, that the advantage depends on the state belonging to the prompt being predicted, so substituting a matched wrong state raises MAE
primary_comparisons.interpretation: No detected difference. Under the preregistered decision rule this is a null result and must not be described as a trend or a direction of travel.
primary_comparisons.name: matched_wrong_state minus true_state
